run_object_detection: run OmDetTurboForObjectDetection to detect objects in images using class names and task prompts
create_language_embeddings: create cached class and task language embeddings using OmDetTurboPreTrainedModel.get_language_embedding
build_encoder_features: build hybrid encoder features with FPN and PAN using OmDetTurboHybridEncoder for multi-scale vision representations
test_decoder_predictions: test OmDetTurboDecoder to predict bounding boxes and class logits from vision and task features
review_deformable_attention: review OmDetTurboMultiscaleDeformableAttention for multi-scale deformable cross-attention in the decoder
